facts.fact_text: A summary of domestic law and practice concerning regulations relating to the conduct of public events, liability for breaches committed in their course, and administrative escorting and arrest can be found in Lashmankin and Others v. Russia, nos. 57818/09 and 14 others, §§ 216-312, 7 February 2017.

A summary of domestic law and practice concerning regulations relating to the conduct of public events, liability for breaches committed in their course, and administrative escorting and arrest can also be found in Novikova and Others v. Russia, nos. 25501/07 and 4 others, §§ 47-85, 26 April 2016.
